title: Binary Search
description: Halve the search range on a sorted array. Closed interval [l, r] with `l <= r`.

notes: Array MUST be sorted — that’s the whole prerequisite.
Loop condition is `l <= r` because [l, r] is a CLOSED interval; missing `=` skips single-element ranges.
Move past m by +1/-1 to guarantee progress and avoid infinite loops.

options: [l, r] is closed; without the equal you miss single-element ranges

questions.q: If you write `l = m` instead of `l = m + 1`:

exercises.prompt: Fill in the classic binary search.

L3.prompt: Write `binarySearch(nums, target)` returning the index of target, or -1. Log `binarySearch([-1, 0, 3, 5, 9, 12], 9)`.
